question: 2025 年第三季的淨營收是多少？
gt_sql: WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-07-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-10-01' ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents),0)/100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=oi.order_id) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds r JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=r.order_id), 2)

question: 2025 年 11 月的客單價是多少？
gt_sql: WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-11-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-12-01' ) SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents)/100.0/COUNT(DISTINCT vo.order_id),2) FROM vo JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=vo.order_id

question: 南部客戶在 2025 年共有多少張有效訂單？
gt_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01' AND c.region_code='TW-S'

question: 銀級會員在 2025 年的淨營收是多少？
gt_sql: WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01' AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE tier='S')) SELECT ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents),0)/100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=oi.order_id) - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds r JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=r.order_id), 2)

question: 2025 年 4 月的退款金額總計是多少？
gt_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds WHERE datetime(refund_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01' AND datetime(refund_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-05-01'

question: 2025 年有效訂單中，透過官網下單的占比是多少（%）？
gt_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(o.channel='web')/COUNT(*),1) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01'

question: 帳篷類商品在 2025 年的淨營收是多少？
gt_sql: WITH vo AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01' ) SELECT ROUND((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price_cents),0)/100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE p.category='tent') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount_twd),0) FROM refunds r JOIN vo ON vo.order_id=r.order_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE p.category='tent'), 2)

question: 因配送延遲而退款的金額，哪個商品類別最高？
gt_sql: SELECT p.category FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE r.reason_code='R4' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2025 年每位回購客戶平均下了幾張有效訂單？
gt_sql: SELECT ROUND(1.0*SUM(c)/COUNT(*),2) FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) c FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING c>=2)

question: 有多少張訂單曾經付款失敗、之後又付款成功？
gt_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM payments GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(payment_status='failed')>=1 AND SUM(payment_status='ok')>=1)
